Our Safety Evaluation score (0.435) is our weakest benchmark and currently marked as low priority, which is a risk both reputationally and competitively. traces.Spark AI:

We can't win on General Capability against better-resourced competitors, so deprioritizing that is correct. We should maintain Coding as our core identity but add Safety as a co-priority — it aligns with user needs, regulatory trends, and could differentiate us from OpenCore (who scores lowest on Safety).
